name: Vike
description: Vike is a Vite-based framework with a flexible, UI-agnostic architecture; with prerendering enabled it emits fully static HTML for every route.
notes: Application framework used as an SSG through prerender: true and vike-react. Markdown is read at build time with import.meta.glob and rendered with marked inside the page data hook; a post route (/posts/@slug) with onBeforePrerenderStart lists every post URL. firstRelease from the first public vite-plugin-ssr release (2021), Vike's predecessor name.
